name: generic
description: Any short vertical video: 8 s clips, English narration, no fixed runtime. Projects override only what differs.
voice: One clear narrator, written for the ear: short sentences, concrete nouns, strong verbs, one idea per breath.
style_rules: The first sentence is the hook: a specific, strange or contradictory fact, not an introduction.
Every clip adds new information or changes the situation; no clip only restates the previous one.
End on an image or a line, not on a summary or a moral.
visual_rules: One continuous shot per clip with one main action; name subject, action, setting, light and camera move.
Vary the camera and framing between adjacent clips so no two clips look like the same shot.
End every visual prompt with: no subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark, no logos.
